charts.title: TIC 178172313 b: orbits around TIC 178172313
charts.description: The orbits of TIC 178172313's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TIC 178172313 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Lafarga et al. 2026 (2026MNRAS.548ag512L), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname LAFARGA_ET_AL_2026): P 4.3731816136 d

charts.title: TIC 178172313 b: its transit
charts.description: TIC 178172313 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 2 sectors (30, 31) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 178172313, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, moved 4 minutes earlier to where TESS measures the dip, inside the published ephemeris's 3-sigma uncertainty of 96 minutes at these dates, then averaged in 9-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Aligned on TESS's dip, 4 min early; 9-min bins.
The ephemeris's own 1σ there is 32 min.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
